title: AMD raises GlobalFoundries wafer commitment to ~$2.1B through 2025

sources.quote: The Company currently estimates that it will purchase approximately $2.1 billion of wafers in total from GF for years 2022 through 2025 under the Amendment.

explain: AMD amended its wafer deal with GlobalFoundries during the 2021 chip shortage, lifting its expected purchases to about $2.1 billion of wafers over 2022-2025 in exchange for more guaranteed capacity. It replaces the earlier $1.6 billion estimate.
